name: San Bernardino County, CA
findings: San Bernardino County has 4,414 nonprofit organizations. 1,363 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,044 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, San Bernardino County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in San Bernardino County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 95 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?
